title: 盒子里空空的
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: visual continuity reference.
Visible characters: NONE; no animals or people visible. Exact total number of visible characters: 0. Do not draw extra background animals. Scene continuity: 同一卧室，盒盖轻开。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 展示松木盒内部空空荡荡；周围安静，夜灯光线柔和。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 安静，不画拟声效果。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 无角色、无叶子、无音符、无发光声波。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: The box interior is empty at this point; the red leaf has not yet been placed inside. Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1: This is the same single pale honey-pine lidded box; preserve its rounded corners and small scale.Light and time lock: This exact scene occurs at night in the bedroom. Show a dark blue night sky outside the window, warm interior lamplight and no daylight.
